messages:
alexa: Hey folks — onboarding snag. My MBP enrollment keeps failing with 'SCEP certificate error' and the browser redirects me to an Okta device-trust page that says 'Approval required'. Anyone able to approve device trust? I attached a screenshot.

it_bot: IT ticket created: #IT-4521 — tagging infra team. Please include the output of `profiles status -type enrollment` and any logs.

luis: tagging @jordan_it — can you take a look? alexa is blocked on device approval.

jordan_it: hey @alexa — sorry about the hit. That Okta "device trust" approval needs a workspace admin (security_admin role) to approve for the org. Two quick checks first:
1) run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output
2) did you sign the Okta MFA push from your phone during the enrollment flow?

alexa: I did the MFA push. here's the command output:
```
$ profiles status -type enrollment
Enrolled: No
EnrollmentStatus: SCEP failure (HTTP 403: approval_required)
LastAttempt: 2026-02-12 14:33:05 +0000
```

alexa: also saw a browser page with a big red badge: "Device trust pending admin approval" and a link to contact admin.

jordan_it: thanks. 403 + approval_required = Okta is blocking SCEP provisioning until device is trusted by an admin. I can escalate but fastest path is to have a workspace admin approve the request in Okta Device Trust -> Pending Requests. @sam_admin can you check?

sam_admin: on it. I see a pending request for alexa@redwood.com. approving now :white_check_mark:

it_bot: Update: IT ticket #IT-4521 updated by sam_admin — device trust approved in Okta.

alexa: re-ran the enrollment after the approval. progress! got a success message and FileVault began encrypting.

alexa: `profiles status` now:
```
$ profiles status -type enrollment
Enrolled: Yes
ProfileIdentifier: com.redwood.corp.mdm
LastSuccessfulEnroll: 2026-02-12 14:38:12 +0000
```

luis: awesome — welcome aboard and congrats on surviving first weird onboarding hiccup :tada:

alexa: thanks everyone, especially @sam_admin and @jordan_it. VPN, Slack SSO, and Docker all working now. marking IT-4521 resolved.

sam_admin: flagged follow-up: we should add clearer instructions in the onboarding doc about the Okta device-trust step and who can approve. I'll open a doc PR.

jordan_it: noted — will add a diagnostics snippet for the SCEP 403 case.

alexa: leaving a quick note in the onboarding doc too about the phone MFA timing — nearly lost the push during the redirect.

luis: nice. if anything else pops up ping #new-hires or DM me. :thumbsup:
